counting_rule: Records include primary papers, an official registry/label, sponsor statements, interpretive context, access metadata and exclusion evidence. They are not independent studies or patients.

sources.title: Altered Dopamine Metabolism and Response to Treatment with Levodopa/Carbidopa in MCT8 Deficiency
sources.access_scope: Firecrawl retrieved full published main text, tables and reference list. Linked videos and supplementary XLSX were not independently read.
supports: Ten phenotyped people but nine evaluable treatment courses; the paper's abstract denominator differs from the main treatment section.

Endpoint-specific outcomes: seven of nine broad clinical benefit; eight of nine hypokinesia/bradykinesia improvement; five of eight GMFM improvement; CGI-I four much improved, two minimally improved, three unchanged.
Functional-category improvements were not congruent; mean dystonia score increased; small, uncontrolled and partly retrospective study.
limitations: No causal treatment effect or population response probability.
No verified combined unique-patient denominator with Wilpert2025.
No transfer-qualified formulation, current license, quote, or complete all-treated safety inference from ten phenotyped patients.
sources.lineage: Italian clinical series; the paper cites Wilpert2025 and shares a coauthor. Different reported recruitment settings do not establish a fully deduplicated pooled cohort.

sources.title: Patients with Allan-Herndon-Dudley Syndrome (MCT8 Deficiency) Display Symptoms of Parkinsonism in Childhood and Respond to Levodopa/Carbidopa Treatment
sources.access_scope: Full published main text, main tables, figure captions and references retrieved with Firecrawl. Supplementary files and videos were not separately audited.
supports: Eleven phenotyped patients, six systematically treated/assessed at one center, two additional separately described exposures including a one-week nonresponse.
Six-person paired movement/disability and parkinsonism-scale improvement; modest fine-motor change.
No significant gross-motor, language or cognitive improvement; CPCHILD did not improve; myoclonus did not improve.
Oral/gastric-tube levodopa/carbidopa suspension was used; authors call for a controlled trial.
limitations: No concurrent randomized comparator.
Extra exposure descriptions do not enlarge paired endpoint denominator.
No pooled unique people with later report.
Preprint and published versions are not independent replication.
sources.lineage: DEEPTYPE-linked clinical observation; six-person assessed cohort plus separately described cases.

sources.title: FDA prescribing information: Emcitate (tiratricol)
sources.access_scope: Firecrawl PDF text extraction of pages1–18 of23; indication and clinical-study sections recovered. Remaining instructions-for-use pages were not inspected.
supports: Initial US approval2026 and September2026 revision.
Labeled treatment is peripheral thyrotoxicosis in adults and pediatric patients with MCT8 deficiency.
limitations: Label scope does not establish levodopa efficacy, comparative neurological superiority or current delivery/price.
Partial document, with coverage sufficient for the quoted indication boundary; no clinical use instructions reproduced.
sources.lineage: Regulatory comparator evidence, not an additional levodopa treatment cohort.

sources.title: Clinical and Biochemical Monitoring of MCT8 Deficiency across the Lifespan: Practical Considerations for Multidisciplinary Care
sources.access_scope: Full publisher article retrieved by Firecrawl, including neurology, methods, cited reference39, funding and conflicts.
supports: Cautious interpretation of levodopa as unproven and not standard/disease-modifying treatment.
Advisory meeting26November2024; targeted literature searchJune2025; no patient data discussed at the meeting.
Neurology paragraph cites the same Wilpert2025 positive clinical report, not a new controlled negative study.
Egetis facilitated/funded meeting and editorial support; article states funder noninvolvement in interpretation.
limitations: Interpretive context, not primary efficacy evidence or a new negative dataset.
Stated search date precedes later MCT8 paper's October2025 publication.
Funding context does not itself invalidate the analysis.
sources.lineage: Overlapping evidence base with H02; not independent clinical replication.

sources.title: Benefit of Salbutamol for the Treatment of Neuromuscular Junction Dysfunction in Patients With PURA Syndrome
sources.access_scope: Full published main text and all three clinical tables retrieved through Firecrawl.
supports: Two original salbutamol recipients; three literature-derived patients in the review; total salbutamol-exposed3, pyridostigmine-exposed4.
Respiratory/motor observations, persistent feeding/ventilatory deficits, later regression in one case, adverse tachycardia/startle/sleep symptoms in another.
Published table: pyridostigmine clear improvement1, partial1, no response1, worsening1.
Authors identify maturation, sequential therapy and publication bias as limitations.
limitations: Third salbutamol recipient is literature-derived, not a new case or independently reread original record.
No concurrent control or population response probability.
Raw infant motor score changes do not isolate maturation; paper's CHOP-INTEND denominator retained as reported.
Does not demonstrate general CNS repair, response biomarker or exact-use commercial rights.
sources.lineage: Two new patient reports plus older Wyrebek2022 and Qashqari2022 cases; the reviewed patients are not additive to their original reports.

sources.title: PURA syndrome: neuromuscular junction manifestations with potential therapeutic implications
sources.access_scope: Firecrawl paper-index canonical metadata and truncated abstract inspected. Paper-read returned no full-text passages. Ordinary publisher scrape returned an access/navigation shell, and PubMed scrape returned only a short landing response. Unpaywall reports closed with null best location.

sources.title: TTI-0102: A Novel Natural Controlled-Release Cysteamine Prodrug for Mitochondrial Disease and Cystinosis
sources.version: v1 preprint; not certified by peer review
sources.access_scope: Full HTML and all15pages of the public PDF retrieved by Firecrawl. PDF URL came from Unpaywall. Text/figure text inspected; complete patient-flow and fatigue-analysis denominator not recovered.
supports: Exact prodrug identity; nine enrolled, six active and three placebo.
Recruitment stopped before12 after PK review; GI intolerance and dropouts reported.
No12-minute walking change; MFIS p=.04 reported.
Single-blind description, no GDF-15/FGF-21 change, glutathione sample-stability issue.
Safety and Discussion differ in body-weight descriptions of intolerance.
limitations: Preprint, single sponsor-author/CEO, sponsor-funded.
No complete interpretable participant disposition or exact MFIS analysis population.
FSS/MFIS and masking differences versus registry unresolved; missing amendments cannot be inferred.
No tolerability superiority over existing cysteamine formulations, general MELAS cure or transfer to other indications.
Unpaywall acceptedVersion metadata does not establish journal acceptance.
sources.lineage: One randomized clinical study NCT06644534 / EUCT2023-506723-28-00; HTML, PDF, registry and sponsor accounts are overlapping records.

sources.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06644534: TTI-0102 versus placebo in MELAS
sources.access_scope: Complete current official registry record including results availability recovered using Firecrawl Alexandria clinicaltrials-gov/clinical-trials/study, nct_id=NCT06644534, include_results=true. Ordinary page scrape had returned only a glossary/site shell.
supports: Nine ACTUAL enrolled; COMPLETED; actual primary/study completion12January2026; no posted results.
Registered primary functional measure12-minute walk and primary safety AEs.
Registered secondary fatigue instrumentFSS and WHOQOL-BREF; MFIS is not listed in the returned outcome fields.
Double-blind prose and quadruple masking categories; IPD sharingNO.
limitations: Registry protocol is not a trial result; historical amendments and SAP not inspected.
Planned12 in design text is not actual enrollment.
Registry versus paper differences are unresolved reporting/protocol questions, not proof of misconduct.

sources.title: Thiogenesis Therapeutics current TTI-0102 pipeline
